goals: Verify the POST /send-message endpoint returns a 400 status for invalid or incomplete request bodies.
Verify the POST /send-message endpoint successfully processes valid message requests with a 200 status.
activities: Initialize an HTTP request to the application.
Set the request method to POST and the path to '/send-message'.
Send a JSON payload `{"name": "john"}` in the request body.
Expect the response 'Content-Type' header to be JSON.
Expect the HTTP status code to be 400.
Initialize an HTTP request to the application.
Set the request method to POST and the path to '/send-message'.
Send a complex JSON payload including 'sender', 'registrationIds', and 'data' in the request body.
Expect the response 'Content-Type' header to be JSON.
Expect the HTTP status code to be 200.
